format: html

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(day_of_week,
                              levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
                              ordered = TRUE))
```

```{r}
births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(mean_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = mean_births)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(x = "Date of Month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean Births")

christmas_data <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    dec25_births    = sum(births[date_of_month == 25]),
    baseline_births = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline = dec25_births / baseline_births * 100,
    dec25_weekday   = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary(christmas_data)

christmas_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline, color = dec25_weekday)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    labs(
      title    = "Fewer Babies Born on Christmas Day",
      subtitle = "December 25 births as a percentage of the average for surrounding days (Dec 20–24, 27–30)",
      x        = "Year",
      y        = "Dec 25 Births (% of Baseline)",
      color    = "Day of Week",
      caption  = "Source: US Births 1994–2014 (CDC / FiveThirtyEight)"
    )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ factor(year) + factor(month) + day_of_week,
                   data = births_tibble)

summary(births_model)$r.squared

births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(paste(2001, month, date_of_month, sep = "-")))
```

```{r}
holidays <- tibble(
  date  = as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-11-22", "2001-12-25")),
  label = c("New Year's", "Independence Day", "Thanksgiving", "Christmas")
) |>
  left_join(calendar_resid, by = "date")

calendar_resid |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
    geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
    geom_point(data = holidays, color = "firebrick", size = 2) +
    geom_text(data = holidays, aes(label = label),
              vjust = 2, size = 3, color = "firebrick") +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b", date_breaks = "1 month") +
    labs(
      title    = "Holiday Dips in US Birth Rates",
      subtitle = "Residuals after adjusting for year, month, and day-of-week effects",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "Mean % Deviation from Expected Births",
      caption  = "Source: US Births 1994\u20132014 (CDC / FiveThirtyEight)"
    )
```
